# Original unsupported 3MF material reference

`lib3mf-composite-materials.3mf` is the unchanged `Tests/TestFiles/Mixed/texcube.3mf` at 3MFConsortium/lib3mf revision `bfb5df00057fae7e306c511fa7c6ff476dfaad28`, SHA-256 `0c6aebf96558689a3ea8d40d5f62ea03278b89178ff97dce6cd25a96b180af36`. Its original BSD-2-Clause license is retained as `LIB3MF-LICENSE.txt`. The model has eight vertices and twelve triangles, and assigns composite materials to two faces alongside its color and texture resources.

Catwalk explicitly rejects these composite and multiproperty resources pending qualified support. This is an unsupported-input regression, rather than a successful gallery example.
